answer: Because the vault salt is published after the lagoon checkpoint, the echo audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 72 keys therefore burns for 72 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 229 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
